ICS 59.060.10, 59.080.50TXD 39Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the constructional particulars and other requirements of braided cotton tapes used in the manufacture of berets.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed in Annex A.
